2 The solubility of potassium chlorate(V) in water increases with temperature. The units of
For
solubility are grams per one hundred grams of water (g / 100g water). Examiner’s
Use
An experiment is carried out to investigate this solubility.
• An empty boiling tube was weighed and the mass recorded.
• Some distilled water was added to the boiling tube and the new mass recorded.
• A small sample of potassium chlorate(V) was added and this new mass recorded.
• The boiling tube was carefully heated with stirring until all the solid had dissolved.
• The apparatus was allowed to cool slowly while constantly stirring and the temperature
recorded when the first crystals appeared in the tube.
